scope: Bounded long-duration sampled Pump receipts, not exhaustive protocol coverage or historical recovery. No database pool is attached to this monitor; database responsiveness is separately validated. Current confirmed WebSocket receipts; strict finalized creation verification; current finalized accounts. Both actual buy and sell simulations required before an entry; mandatory-risk failures are durably rejected before simulation. No invented fill or risk overrides. Public RPC errors and unsupported variants are retained.
